pages.title: Overview
pages.text: Fuel power is the most dependable AC source: as long as the furnace keeps burning, the Faraday Generator keeps outputting, 200 EP/s by default. It is made of two devices — a $(item)Stirling Engine$() sitting on the furnace, and a $(item)Faraday Generator$() that turns the mechanical energy into electricity.

pages.title: Stirling Engine
pages.text: The engine must sit $(l)directly above$() a $(l)burning$() furnace, blast furnace, smoker, oven or advanced furnace, otherwise it pops straight off.$(br2)Using a sponge on the engine quiets it down considerably; right-click with a Crowbar to get the sponge back.

pages.title: Faraday Generator
pages.text: Turns mechanical energy into AC, 200 EP/s by default (adjustable in the config). It stores nothing and connects to nothing: a Tesla Coil must draw from it directly, or an AC/DC Converter must bank its power into a battery.$(br2)The engine only recognises the "burning" state, so when the furnace burns out the output stops.
